arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Ross argued that most states protected mobile homes in 1986.
Mr. Fisher argued that the government's definition would include Tennessee law.
Justice Gorsuch noted that empty cars differ from homes in risk.
Justice Sotomayor distinguished mobile homes from vehicles based on propulsion.
